steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, everything went according to plan here, and we've captured Jack Naper's four accomplices.
Great. And I've located the man himself.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Do you need backup?
I'm good. I can handle it.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Copy that.
You hang up. The wind is strong on the rooftop. You run your fingers through your hair and move on ahead.
Jack Naper is right there.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: The nightscape of Eastside is splendid, isn't it?
Yes, enjoy it while you can.
You'll be locked up in a dark cell soon, and you might not have another chance of enjoying this view.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Oh, is that so?

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: I say you'd better stay where you are.
Jack turns around. He is holding a rod-shaped gadget with a button on it.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Latest remote detonator, impervious to electromagnetic interference. Cool, huh?

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Good. Now we're talking.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Well, if it isn't Miss Mess! Thank you for your help. I've been having a blast lately.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You're welcome.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: I hear that the new Chief of the MBCC is a force to be reckoned with. Only a few months on the job, and the Chief has pulled off quite a few high-profile missions.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: But shouldn't you be dealing with Sinners and Mania? Where do you find the time to hang out with a law-abiding citizen like me?
Law-abiding citizen? You?

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: My old man is well-respected in Eastside...

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: I'm his only child. Of course I'm a law-abiding citizen.
Do you know what you're doing?

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Having fun.
Having fun?!

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: You don't understand the pain of being the son of a successful man.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: My life was a bore.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Money, luxuries, all the usual forms of entertainment had lost their appeal to me. And there wasn't much else to do.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Sometimes I even envied those Syndican hooligans. To make things worse, Yagyu was gone; and gone was my only source of merriment, manhunt.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That's discrimination! I'm from Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Whatever. It doesn't matter where you come from. This city has long been a hopeless mess.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Life was so boring and tiring. I was trying to make the best out of a bad situation.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: And I found my new toys.
Jack looks down at the pedestrians on the street, each the size of an ant.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: They're so weak, so naive. They think that as long as they stay in Eastside, their futures are secure. They live their lives from one day to the next in a state of numbing bliss. It makes me sick.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: That's why it's so funny to see their sad faces and hear their wailing when they are forced into a corner.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Surely you agree with me, Miss Mess, right? Or you wouldn't have made that for me.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I certainly don't agree with you.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You're doing this for fun. Ugh! That's distasteful.
Good, since you don't approve of what he is doing, then...

options: Order Mess to stop the culprit

choices.text: Order Mess to stop the culprit

steps.content: Stop him, now!
You made the weapon, and you know his plan. You must have a contingency plan; I know your style.
Nullify his weapon, or restrain him directly.
Do whatever needs to be done; just stop him before he presses the button.
Mess tilts her head and looks at you with great interest. And then she turns you down outright, punctuating each and every word of her refusal.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I DON'T WANT TO.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What makes you think that I'll be able to stop him? I'm just a blacksmith.
You're also a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Do Sinners have a duty to stop others from causing harm?
No, that's my duty.
But you're my Sinner.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Heh...

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Hey!
As you and Mess argue, Jack feels neglected, which seems to have angered him.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Where are your manners? You're supposed to look at the person you're talking to.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You talk too much.
Mess doesn't turn her head, still looking at you straight in the eyes.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: W-what did you say?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Shut up! Stay there and be quiet. Do not interrupt us!

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Aren't... aren't you afraid of me pressing the button? You made this. You know how powerful it is!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yes, I made it, and it's just a piece of iron now.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Try it. See if I'm telling the truth.
Jack's face turns an ugly color. He looks at the gadget in his hand, then back at you. He can't seem to summon up the courage to press the button.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahaha! Fooled you, you little coward! I can't nullify that thing.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What a loser! You're useless without your father.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You think you can always count on your dad to bail you out, huh? Now the Chief of the MBCC has got involved; things have got nasty for you. This time, even your dad won't be able to get you out of trouble.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: And you're too cowardly to press the button. You're using that thing as a deterrent, but the moment you press the button, you'll be arrested. Am I right?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ... So pathetic. Without your dear daddy protecting you, you don't even dare to step out of line.
Enough!
Jack's face is contorting out of shape. You can't let Mess provoke him further.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ah, you want to join this taunting game, Chief? Or do you think I'm going too far, and you want to give him a hand?
Stop wasting time. Go stop him.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: No can do.
An annoying smile takes up her whole face.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: His malice is about to burst through. I'm going to make a good harvest.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Or... you can use your shackles to force me to stop him. Isn't this what you are good at, manipulating your Sinners?
I don't use my shackles if I can help it. But right now I don't seem to have a choice.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Really?
A light of joy dances in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Bring it on!
Red light wrapped around her torso, she moves forward silently, one hand stretched out to Jack.

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: No, no... Stop! What are you doing?!

steps.speaker: Jack Naper
steps.content: Ahhh!
Mess' hand reaches for Jack. A stream of dark energy pours out of his chest and gathers around Mess' fingertips.
Then Jack falls onto the floor, unconscious.
You turn on the communications device.
The culprit has been apprehended. Get a team over here and take him back, ASAP.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Why...
Your conversation with the response team member is disrupted by a cry uttered by Mess, who has her back to you.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Why, why, why, why...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Anger, disappointment, frustration...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You had such an abundance of emotions that could have been turned into malice. Why...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You were facing an incurable scumbag and a Sinner, and you couldn't even give me a tiny bit of malice. Why?!
Listen, Mess.
I don't know why you're so obsessed with the concept of malice. I don't know what you've gone through.
But you're my Sinner now. I'll give you time to overcome it, to shed your dark past.
But at the moment, I have a more urgent business to deal with. I must save the Eastsiders, whether or not they are manipulated by the thing you mentioned.
This is my duty.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Heh... I planned this for so long, I put so much energy into the plan, and all I got in return is this...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Doesn't it make me look like a clown?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Why couldn't you just be a bad person like the rest of us?
What are you talking about?
Mess' voice is a whisper, barely audible above the whistling of the wind.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I said...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I WANT YOU TO DISAPPEAR!!
A blade appears in Mess' hand out of nowhere. A dark aura runs the length of the blade, giving off a sinister vibe.
Mess raises the blade and hacks at the sky with all her strength.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh!!
She hacks at it again, and again, and again... The thick clouds in the sky are split open, as if by invisible air currents.
She keeps on swishing the sword until she wears herself out and falls onto the floor.
She lies there for what seems like a long time.
You hear weak sniffles.
What... On earth are you fighting against?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The thing...
The thing?
Mess mentioned it before, but you don't know what it really is.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Do you remember my dream? The dream in which we met for the first time.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You must have forgotten it. But not me.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I remember every dream I've ever had. I will never forget them.
You remember it now.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That's the only good dream in my memory; I'm not lying.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Although what happened in the dream was not real, we did beat it there.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: But no one can beat it in the real world.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: It took control of my dad, my mom, and everyone else I ever met...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I still don't understand why it doesn't take control of you. Your shackles... It's such a dark entity.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I might have had a chance of beating it if I had been able to take advantage of you...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I sometimes wonder whether it would be better if I just died.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That way, at least I could put an end to the tortures.
Where is it?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: It's right there. Can't you see it?
Mess raises her limp arm and points at the sky.
It's a clear sky dotted with a moon and many stars. They give out a soft light, but nothing more.
I can't see it, Mess.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You can't see it? Of course you can't. Who else can see it but me?
...Maybe you can learn to trust other people. Believe in their strength to contain the malice within them, instead of leading them to destruction.
I don't know if the thing you're talking about is real or not. Either way, you now are a Sinner under the MBCC.
You can rely on me, on us. You don't have to fight on your own in this whirlpool of madness.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Rely on you? Don't make me laugh. You can't even see the enemy I'm fighting. Rely on you?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Maybe they're right. Maybe I'm the one who has a problem. Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Maybe I'm just a lunatic... Forever fighting an enemy invisible to everyone else...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahahaha...!
You don't know how to comfort the girl before you.
She is normally cunning, vicious, and hard to figure out.
Now she looks so vulnerable. It's hard to decide which is the real her.
As you ponder, Nightingale's voice pipes up in your earphone.
Yes, it's been taken care of. The culprit has been restrained.
No, no accident, she, er, she is stable at the moment, not a danger.
You take a glance at the sightless girl on the floor.
What will become of her, I don't know. But we must help her, no matter what.
